observation: 38% of supplier invoices require manual intervention
immediate_cause: Invoice arrives with no PO reference
root_cause: Requisition policy not enforced; buying outside the channel carries no consequence

observation: Close takes 9 days against a 6.4-day median
immediate_cause: Intercompany differences identified late in the cycle
root_cause: No agreed intercompany settlement calendar and no single owner

observation: Three competing versions of revenue by region circulate
immediate_cause: Each function builds its own extract
root_cause: No agreed metric definition and no owning system of record

observation: Analysts spend 70% of the month preparing data
immediate_cause: Data pulled and cleansed by hand from two ERPs
root_cause: Reporting layer requires manual assembly; no integrated data model

evidence: AR ageing and cash application log June 2026
immediate_cause: Remittances arrive in a shared mailbox and are matched by hand
root_cause: Role never redesigned after the bank changed remittance format

observation: DSO of 47 days against a 30-day top quartile
immediate_cause: No behaviour-based dunning; collectors also handle disputes
root_cause: Collections not designed as a distinct role with a defined ladder

observation: Forecast cycle takes 6 weeks and is bottom-up only
immediate_cause: Every cost centre forecasts every line
root_cause: No driver-based model or forecast policy

observation: Supplier master duplicates across two ERPs
immediate_cause: No single system of entry for supplier records
root_cause: Master data ownership never assigned after the 2023 acquisition

observation: Manual journals make up 39% of all postings
immediate_cause: Recurring entries posted by hand each month
root_cause: No journal automation standard; upload templates unmanaged

observation: Balance sheet reconciliations prepared in Excel
immediate_cause: No reconciliation tool; review by email
root_cause: Control designed as detective inspection rather than prevention at source
